  {"step":4,"file":"src/libespeak-ng/ssml.c","function":"ProcessSsmlTag","line":588,"var":"len/xml_buf","code":"len = wcslen(xml_buf); if (xml_buf[len - 1] == '/') { xml_buf[len - 1] = ' '; self_closing = true; }","note":"The tag buffer is treated as a mutable wide string and self-closing syntax is normalized before attribute parsing."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/libespeak-ng/ssml.c","function":"ProcessSsmlTag","line":677,"var":"ssml_sp","code":"ssml_sp = &ssml_stack[*n_ssml_stack-1];","note":"The current SSML stack frame is selected; later close-tag handling assumes the stack depth and top frame remain consistent."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/libespeak-ng/ssml.c","function":"ProcessSsmlTag","line":906,"var":"n_ssml_stack","code":"while ((*n_ssml_stack > 1) && (ssml_stack[*n_ssml_stack-1].tag_type != SSML_SPEAK)) (*n_ssml_stack)--;","note":"Closing <speak> unwinds the stack by decrementing the depth until the matching frame is found."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/libespeak-ng/ssml.c","function":"ProcessSsmlTag","line":915,"var":"n_ssml_stack/ssml_sp","code":"return terminator + GetVoiceAttributes(px, tag_type, ssml_sp, ssml_stack, *n_ssml_stack, ...);","note":"After unwinding, the code still reuses the previously selected frame pointer and current depth to compute voice attributes."},
  {"step":8,"file":"src/libespeak-ng/ssml.c","function":"GetVoiceAttributes","line":357,"var":"ssml_sp","code":"ssml_sp = &ssml_stack[n_ssml_stack++];","note":"Opening voice/speak tags push new frames onto the fixed SSML stack, so malformed nesting can drive the depth and top-frame selection."},
  {"step":9,"file":"src/libespeak-ng/ssml.c","function":"VoiceFromStack","line":217,"var":"voice_name/language","code":"strcpy(voice_name, ssml_stack[0].voice_name); strcpy(language, ssml_stack[0].language);","note":"Voice selection copies stack-derived strings into fixed-size local buffers; corrupted or inconsistent stack state can make later reads walk past intended bounds and trigger the reported stack-buffer-overflow READ."}
